name: Friend trivia
summary: Trivia a friend wrote about the group: answer fast, see who picked what, race the friends who played.
useWhen: someone wrote quiz questions about the group and wants everyone to play
'how well do you know us' with real questions and answers given
dontUseWhen: no questions and answers were given: never write them

params.questions: 1 to 5: about (a name or 'the group'), q, options (2 to 4), answer (index)
params.played: friends who already played: name, picks per question, points per question
